configurationDescription: Manage organization-wide settings that apply across all projects.
businessPlanRequiredDescription: Organization-level task restriction settings are available on Business and Enterprise plans.
restrictTaskCreation: Restrict task assignment to Admins and Team Leads
restrictTaskCreationTooltip: When enabled, only Admins and Team Leads can create and assign tasks across all projects. Team Members can only view tasks assigned to them. Project-level settings override this organization-level setting.
restrictTaskCreationNote: Note: Project-level settings take priority over this organization-level setting. Changes take effect immediately.
limitTimelogBackdating: Limit how far back time can be logged
limitTimelogBackdatingTooltip: When enabled, members cannot create a time log dated earlier than the allowed number of days. Applies to everyone, including Owners and Admins. Running timers and imported logs are unaffected.
timelogBackdateLimitDays: Maximum days a time log can be backdated
timelogBackdateLimitNote: Note: Existing time logs are never altered. Editing an already-old log stays possible as long as its date is not changed.
